note.t: 2025 annual report (filed Aug. 13, 2026 after a June extension). The negative range is mostly an artifact: his Mobile home is not a reportable asset, but its joint mortgage with Carter Bank & Trust ($1M–$5M, Nov. 2022) must be listed. Assets: his spouse's rental property in Greenbelt, Md. ($500K–$1M; rent $15K–$50K), her KDF Consulting LLC ($50K–$100K), two life-insurance policies, and SAK Investments LLC (wholly his), which owns 33% of CMB Holdings Group LLC, a Birmingham sports bar/restaurant venue — value listed 'undetermined', business revenue $100,001–$1M. Other liabilities: the spouse's Greenbelt mortgage ($250K–$500K) and two student loans ($50K–$100K each). No stock transactions, gifts, travel or outside positions; no foreign assets or income.
